skill.name: typeset

content.value_statement: Inconsistent typography weakens readability and makes interfaces feel unfinished. This skill guides font choice, hierarchy, scale, spacing, and verification for polished text.
actual_capabilities: Evaluates font choices against brand personality and overused generic defaults.
Defines hierarchy through size, weight, color, spacing, and consistent roles.
Selects sizing strategies for app interfaces, marketing pages, and content pages.
Improves readability through line length, line height, contrast, and body text minimums.
Refines typography details such as numeric alignment, letter spacing, semantic tokens, and kerning.
Verifies hierarchy, accessibility, performance, and consistency after changes.
limitations: Does not include automated visual testing or screenshot comparison by itself.
Depends on available brand context, design goals, and implementation files.
Does not resolve font licensing, hosting contracts, or paid font procurement.
Requires human review for subjective brand fit and final visual quality.

use_cases.title: Polish a Web Application
use_cases.description: Review dense interface screens and make text hierarchy, sizing, and readability more consistent.

use_cases.title: Strengthen a Marketing Page
use_cases.description: Tune headings, body copy, and font pairing so the page feels intentional and easier to scan.

use_cases.title: Standardize a Typography System
use_cases.description: Create stable roles for sizes, weights, spacing, and tokens across reusable interface components.

prompt_templates.title: Review Basic Typography
prompt_templates.prompt: Review the typography in TARGET. Identify font, hierarchy, sizing, readability, and consistency issues before suggesting changes.

prompt_templates.title: Improve a Screen
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the typeset skill on TARGET. Create a focused plan, then update the type scale, weights, spacing, and readability issues.

prompt_templates.title: Adapt Typography by Context
prompt_templates.prompt: Assess TARGET as either an app UI, marketing page, or content page. Choose a sizing strategy and explain the tradeoffs.

prompt_templates.title: Refactor a Typography System
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit TARGET for repeated text roles, inconsistent tokens, loading performance, and accessibility. Propose a reusable typography system and verification checklist.

output_examples.input: A dashboard uses similar sizes for headings, labels, and body text.
output: Identified weak hierarchy between titles, section labels, and supporting text.
Recommended a five-level type scale with clearer weight roles.
Adjusted body text, captions, and numeric tables for easier scanning.

output_examples.input: A landing page feels generic and hard to read on mobile.
output: Suggested a more distinctive font pairing that still supports long-form readability.
Recommended fluid display headings and stable body text sizing.
Added checks for line length, contrast, zoom behavior, and font loading.

best_practices: Gather brand, audience, and page context before changing fonts or scale.
Use size, weight, color, and spacing together to create hierarchy.
Verify readability, contrast, zoom behavior, and font loading after implementation.
anti_patterns: Replacing every font with a trendy display face without checking readability.
Using arbitrary sizes that do not map to stable roles.
Disabling user zoom or using fixed pixel sizes for body text.

faq.question: What does the typeset skill improve?
faq.answer: It improves font choice, hierarchy, sizing, weights, spacing, readability, and verification for interface text.

faq.question: Can it help with design systems?
faq.answer: Yes. It can define reusable type roles, weight rules, spacing patterns, and token naming guidance.

faq.question: Does it replace visual design judgment?
faq.answer: No. It gives structured typography guidance, but final brand fit and visual quality need human review.

faq.question: How does it handle accessibility?
faq.answer: It checks readable body sizes, contrast, line length, zoom behavior, and comfortable line height.

faq.question: Can I use it with Claude, Codex, and Claude Code?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill metadata lists Claude, Codex, and Claude Code as supported tools.

faq.question: What input should I provide?
faq.answer: Provide the target screen, page, component, or files, plus any brand and audience context.
